model.note: Python model of both drivers; its numbers are expectations without a rule, not evidence

declared_rules_unchanged: strategy RobustStiff or declared regime Stiff -> RODAS5P leg with max_steps
DOPRI5 not admitted (mass matrix, dense output, events) -> RODAS5P leg
supplied Jacobian, JVP or band -> RODAS5P leg (D2)
both entry points validated before any callback; a refusal is Err before any callback
algorithm.break_even_length: b = ceil((2 n^2 + 54 n + 384) / 156) in integer arithmetic, from c_D = (6, 52 n) and c_R = (n + 9 [+2 non-autonomous without f_t], (2 n^3 + 54 n^2 + 384 n) / 3); b = 3, 4, 4, 5, 7, 8, 78 for n = 1, 2, 3, 4, 8, 10, 64
algorithm.located_rule: DOPRI5 attempts count only after its first accepted attempt that was not growth-capped (proposed next step != trial step * max_factor, exact equality) or that followed a rejection
algorithm.pilot_times: when the DOPRI5 attempt count first reaches b * 2^k (k = 0, 1, ...) and at least b located attempts exist
algorithm.pilot: H = t_D - (time before the oldest of the last b attempts); if 0, H = that attempt's requested step; if t1 - t_D <= H pilots stop (horizon); otherwise one RODAS5P attempt from DOPRI5's accepted state with h0 = H and max_steps = 1 (Rodas5p::solve_observed_bounded), charged to the counters and to max_steps
algorithm.handover: accepted pilot -> legs [DOPRI5 t0..t_D, RODAS5P pilot step t_D..t_D+H], then the RODAS5P leg from (t_D + H, y_pilot) with h0 = H and the attempts left; lost pilot -> the DOPRI5 session continues bit-identically
algorithm.fatal: a fatal callback inside a pilot ends the solve with CallbackFailed and the accepted prefix (D1); a recoverable error rejects the pilot's attempt
algorithm.dopri5_stops: a numerical DOPRI5 stop (StepUnderflow, NonFinite, Controller) hands over to RODAS5P from the last accepted state with the attempts left, as today; exhaustion of max_steps is MaxStepsReached{max_steps}

discriminators.E1_economy: over all cases (problem x tolerance x options) where T and N succeed, excluding kt_vanishing: geometric mean of cost(N)/cost(T) < 1 in callbacks and in operations; and max over cases of cost(N)/min(cost(D), cost(R)) < the same maximum for T, in each unit (min over those of D and R that succeed)
discriminators.E2_no_new_failure: no case where T succeeds and N does not, at the same max_steps
discriminators.E3_neutrality: every N run without a handover has the final-state bits and the DOPRI5 counters of D plus exactly the pilots' counters, and cost <= 2 cost(D) in each unit; every run decided by a declared fact equals T bit for bit
discriminators.E4_budget: attempts over all legs and pilots <= max_steps; exhaustion reports MaxStepsReached{max_steps}
discriminators.E5_callbacks: no closure entry before DOPRI5's first stage; no entry with t = t0 except DOPRI5's stages; every entry that is not a stage is a finite-difference column or time-derivative call of a RODAS5P attempt that starts at an accepted state; uncharged entries = 0
discriminators.E6_determinism: the three runs have equal digests, counters and bits
discriminators.E7_accuracy: err(N) <= 3 max(err(D), err(R)) over those of D and R that succeed, excluding kt_vanishing
discriminators.E8_callback_cases: F2 succeeds under N; P_fatal reports CallbackFailed{Rhs, 'sensor offline'}; N2 ends with CallbackFailed at its first pilot (D1)
discriminators.E9_v03b_bounded_work: P_heat_fd <= 5890 and P_scalar_fd <= 181818 charged right-hand sides (the V03b bound W), with a recorded handover
discriminators.E10_pilot_accounting: pilots <= 1 + floor(log2(A_D / b)) and pilot spend <= DOPRI5 spend in each unit, on every run
